games:2026-wk12-georgia-south-carolina.blurb: No. 1 Georgia is a 14.5-point favorite at No. 21 South Carolina, with ESPN's model pegging the Bulldogs at 87%. The Gamecocks don't get many better chances to flip the top of the sport on its head at home.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-lsu-tennessee.blurb: Unranked LSU is a 1.5-point favorite at No. 9 Tennessee, and ESPN's model splits it almost exactly down the middle at 50.1%. With the total at 45.5, expect a tight, defense-tilted night in Knoxville.

games:2026-wk12-kentucky-missouri.blurb: No. 16 Kentucky walks into Columbia as a 4.5-point underdog, with ESPN giving Missouri a 61.6% edge in a game the total pegs at just 49.5. The Wildcats are the only ranked team on the field, which makes this a pure banana peel for their resume.

games:2026-wk12-ucla-michigan.blurb: No. 4 UCLA is only a 3.5-point favorite in Ann Arbor, and ESPN's model splits it nearly down the middle at 53.4-46.6. With a 35.5 total, this projects as a grind-it-out afternoon in which one possession could cost the Bruins their spot atop the Big Ten race.

games:2026-wk12-ohio-state-nebraska.blurb: No. 14 Ohio State heads to Lincoln laying four points with a 42.5 total, still trying to climb out of bubble territory. A slip in Memorial Stadium would undo the Buckeyes' recent surge in a hurry.

games:2026-wk12-texas-tech-baylor.blurb: No. 12 Texas Tech is a 5.5-point favorite in Waco with the number up at 57.5, so points should come in bunches. ESPN gives the Red Raiders a 61.5% shot, and with Tech sitting right on the playoff cut line, there's no margin for a Big 12 road stumble.

games:2026-wk12-san-diego-state-boise-st.blurb: No. 17 Boise State is a 20.5-point home favorite over San Diego State, and ESPN's model all but rubber-stamps it at 93.9%. The 60.5 total suggests the Broncos should have plenty of chances to make the margin look the part.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-utah-tcu.blurb: No. 2 Utah visits TCU as an 8.5-point favorite with a 72.5% win probability and a modest 46.5 total. The Utes are the Big 12's frontrunner, so anything other than a clean night in Fort Worth reopens the league race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-houston-west-v.blurb: No. 20 Houston is a 6.5-point favorite in Morgantown in a game with a gaudy 71.5 total. The Cougars have been sliding and need a road win to stop the bleeding.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-byu-kansas.blurb: No. 10 BYU lays 4.5 at Kansas with the total set at 46.5. The Cougars are chasing Utah in the Big 12, and a loss in Lawrence would effectively end that pursuit.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-iowa-illinois.blurb: No. 15 Iowa is an 8.5-point favorite at Illinois in a game with a low 40.5 total, which sounds exactly like an Iowa game. The Hawkeyes are on the outside of the playoff field looking in and can't afford a November hiccup.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-oregon-michiga.blurb: Oregon hammered Michigan State 45-7 in East Lansing, pushing its win streak to four with the playoff picture in mind. Brandon Smith ran for 121 yards and two scores filling in at running back before limping off, and kicker Gage Hurych added a 15-yard touchdown run on a fake field goal; the Spartans' lone answer was a Jaziun Patterson 1-yard plunge in a second half Oregon controlled.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arizona-kansas.blurb: No. 19 Arizona is a 10-point favorite in Manhattan and ESPN gives the Wildcats a 74% shot. The total sits at 53.5, so Arizona will likely need to keep scoring to hold the number.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-arkansas-texas.blurb: No. 5 Texas hosts Arkansas as an 18.5-point favorite with a 94.2% win probability. The total of 46.5 says the Longhorns' defense is expected to do most of the heavy lifting.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wake-forest-ge.blurb: No. 11 Wake Forest is a 22.5-point road favorite at Georgia Tech with the total at 55.5. The Demon Deacons are chasing Miami in the ACC and need to keep stacking convincing wins.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-smu-notre-dame.blurb: No. 6 Notre Dame welcomes SMU as a 20.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Irish a 93.3% chance. With a 55.5 total, this is a style-points opportunity more than a toss-up.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-maryland-usc.blurb: No. 18 USC is favored by 17.5 over Maryland at home and sits at 93.2% in ESPN's model. The 56.5 total points to the Trojans scoring plenty.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-vanderbilt-flo.blurb: No. 24 Florida lays 13.5 at home against Vanderbilt with the total at 47.5. A freshly ranked Gator team gets a chance to prove the ranking is no fluke.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-texas-a-m-okla.blurb: No. 22 Oklahoma is a seven-point home favorite over Texas A&M in a game with a stingy 36.5 total. ESPN gives the Sooners a 61% edge in what looks like a defensive slog in Norman.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-virginia-tech-.blurb: No. 7 Miami hosts Virginia Tech as a 20.5-point favorite with a 96.3% win probability. The Hurricanes lead the ACC race, and the 61.5 total hints at a long night for the visitors.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-indiana-washin.blurb: No. 8 Indiana goes to Washington favored by 9.5 with a 78.9% win probability. The Hoosiers are the closest chaser to UCLA in the Big Ten, so a road win keeps that pressure on.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-pittsburgh-lou.blurb: No. 23 Louisville is a 12.5-point home favorite over Pittsburgh and sits at 77% in ESPN's model. The total is 50.5, giving the Cardinals room to make a statement at the back of the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-chattanooga-al.blurb: No. 3 Alabama is a 46.5-point favorite over FCS Chattanooga. The only real question is how long the starters stay on the field with the SEC race still live.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk12-wofford-ole-mi.blurb: No. 25 Ole Miss hosts Wofford as a 49.5-point favorite. This is a tune-up, nothing more, with a 60.5 total attached.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky slid from 11th to 16th and the advanced numbers are lukewarm — 42nd in SP+, 34th in FPI. The Wildcats look like a team the metrics never fully bought.

predictions:boise-state.blurb: Boise State jumped from 24 to 17 and backs it up with a No. 22 SP+ mark, though FPI is a bit cooler at 31. The Pac-12 Broncos are trending the right direction at the right time.

predictions:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State surged from 20th to 14th, and the metrics think that's still too low: fourth in SP+, fifth in FPI. No team in the Top 25 has a bigger gap between its ranking and its underlying profile.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA holds at No. 4, but the models aren't sold — 12th in SP+ and just 25th in FPI. The Bruins' ranking is built on results more than resume-adjusted dominance.

predictions:houston.blurb: Houston tumbled from 14 to 20, with SP+ (25th) and FPI (30th) both suggesting the fall was earned. The Cougars need wins to arrest the slide.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: The SEC's auto bid is the tightest race on the board: No. 1 Georgia leads with No. 3 Alabama just two spots behind. Any Bulldogs slip and the Tide are right there to take it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: No. 4 UCLA holds the Big Ten's automatic bid with No. 8 Indiana four spots back and still very much in range. Both play road games this week that could reshuffle the order.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-acc.blurb: No. 7 Miami sits atop the ACC with No. 11 Wake Forest the nearest challenger, four spots adrift. The Demon Deacons need the Hurricanes to blink.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: The Big 12 is the least suspenseful of the Power Four races, with No. 2 Utah eight spots clear of No. 10 BYU. Barring a Utah stumble, that auto bid is spoken for.

bubbleNotes:ohio-state.blurb: Ohio State jumped six spots to the 15 seed but is still three places outside the field. The arrow is pointing up fast — it just needs a couple more weeks of it.

bubbleNotes:oregon.blurb: Oregon moved up three to the 14 seed and now sits two spots from the bracket. The Ducks have won four straight and are making the committee think about it.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech holds steady at the 13 seed, the first team out and just one spot from the field. Nothing is wrong, but nothing is moving either — the Red Raiders need help or a statement.

bubbleNotes:iowa.blurb: Iowa is flat at the 16 seed, four spots from the field and the furthest back of the bubble four. Style points would help as much as wins at this stage.
